newsitem.title: UK: South Brazil cited among new sugar freight inquiry.
newsitem.headline: South Brazil cited among new sugar freight inquiry.

text.p: South Brazil dominated the fresh enquiry seen on London's sugar freight market at the of the week but reported firmer business was still thin on the ground, shipbrokers said on Monday.
At least two charterers quoted an account order for a 14,000-tonne bagged cargo from Santos to Algiers for August 25/30, they said.
Secretan issued a number of account orders, mainly for bagged sugar from south Brazil.

It quoted for 14,000 tonnes to Black Sea/Red Sea for August 15/25, 13/14,000 to Med/Black Sea/Red Sea/east Africa/Indian Ocean for August 11/18 and another 10,500 tonnes to Colombo/Bangladesh for August 12/18.
Secretan was also open for 12,500/14,000 tonnes, again in bags, from north France to Umm Qasr for August 14/18 and 10,300/10,600 tonnes in bulk from Kandla to Leixoes for August 7/12.
E D & F Man was open for 14,000 tonnes min/max bagged sugar from Durban to Iran for August 14/20 and a further 14,000 tonnes min/max from Veracruz to Baltic/Black Sea for August 11/15.
SIIC was open on account for 12,500 tonnes of bagged sugar from Adabiyah to Umm Qasr for prompt dates.
